verdict.rationale: YubiKey ships companion software (the ykman CLI, Yubico Authenticator, SDKs), so whether telemetry can be disabled is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
